description: Offline source-candidate normalization of retained Iowa center/preschool observations, with separate postal fields and source-reported points of unknown accuracy.
redirect_policy: No source requests; bounded independent verification of retained app-contained evidence.
retry: No automatic retry or source repull; reuse verified immutable acquired inputs.
checkpoint: Source-linked records, quarantine and conserved summary independently replayed before manifest-last publication.
idempotency: Bind acquired manifest, checksum, run, execution mode and transformation version; preserve every source ordinal and duplicate row.
cancellation: Cooperative replay and drained writes; remove only owned incomplete cancellation outputs and preserve uncertain committed evidence.
retention_profile: Internal source candidates with selected raw lineage, unknown status/address role/update time, separate ZIP5/ZIP4 and no invented geographic assignment.
